evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator reported that no requested email was found; this tests a downstream deliverable that depends on identifying the repository statistics, rather than directly testing whether both statistics were identified.

evaluator_revealed_alternatives.description: The evaluator directly reported that the requested email was absent, an independently sufficient task failure beyond the frozen statistics-identification predicate.

chains.rationale: The evaluator checks for the requested email, while the frozen affected predicate concerns identifying both repository statistics. The bridge is indirect: the actual star and contributor counts were required to compose the specified email. The reused navigation misconception amplified delay but was recovered when the trajectory returned to the Code page. The evaluator-reported absence of any email and the frozen misdirected-tab-navigation-loop provide sufficient alternative explanations for failure, so the recovered reuse defect cannot receive an observed-contribution linkage label.

summary: The evaluator reported no email, which is indirectly related to the frozen repository-statistics predicate through the required email composition. Because the reuse defect was recovered and sufficient alternative failure explanations are supported, the chain is classified as co-occurrence only.
